profile.headline: Software Engineer at Averna
profile.summary:
Software and Hardware Engineer with 6+ years of experience designing and scaling automated validation systems across hardware and software platforms. Skilled in FPGA-based data acquisition, real-time test automation, and CI/CD pipelines to improve throughput, reliability, and test coverage in fast-paced engineering environments.

Proven record of leading cross-disciplinary teams to deliver robust validation platforms for consumer electronics, automotive, and industrial applications. Experience spans hardware performance testing, system-level integration, and infrastructure optimization across U.S. and international sites.

Passionate about building scalable systems that enable innovation, reduce time-to-market, and increase quality. Fluent in English and Spanish, and experienced collaborating across international, cross-functional teams.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · On-site
positions.description:
· Led cross-disciplinary teams to design and deploy 10 FPGA-based data acquisition stations, enabling 24/7 qualification of over 1,000 electromechanical valves in two months.
· Built multi-language GUIs (Python, C++, LabVIEW) for RF circuit and EV charger validation, supporting a project and accelerating time-to-market to seven months.
· Introduced CI/CD automation that reduced release cycles from days to minutes, increasing reliability and efficiency.
· Debugged and optimized real-time data acquisition test sequences, doubling sensing capacity (40 → 80 channels) and expanding supported instruments (5 → 10).

positions.title: Systems integration engineer
positions.description:
· Designed robotic interface systems for apparel printing, reducing cycle time from 10 to 6 seconds.
· Implemented automated robotic impact hammer with object recognition for modal analysis, capturing 100 points with 3 repetitions in 5 minutes, increasing accuracy and repeatability.

positions.title: Project Engineering
positions.description:
· Built automated GUI-based data acquisition and analysis software for predictive maintenance and failure diagnosis.
· Integrated IR thermal imagery, vibration, and ultrasonic sensors to monitor and optimize automotive manufacturing equipment.

positions.title: Camp Counselor
positions.description:
· Took care of groups of around 8 kids, 24 hours for a week, being a different group every week.
· Planned activities and direct contact with the parents.

projects.title: Educational Resource Using Optical Fibers to Send Color Images
projects.description:
· Educational resource to teach optical fibers principles sending color images from one Arduino to another in the same or different computers.
· Using a LabVIEW graphical user interface to select and send the image in real time.

projects.title: Programmer and promoter of independent Amazon Alexa’s Skills
projects.description:
· Independet programmer of Alexa Skills currently published in the skill store.
· Used JavaScript, NodeJS, Python, DynamoDB and AWS to create unique user experiences and complex skills.
· Published skills with more than 10,000 unique users.
· Participated in several contests and workshops.
